summary: I also think it will make more sense to go microformats ->json-> xAPI to create constraints o. n metadata. xAPI allows any affinity group to create vocabularies. At some point this just becomes words, not data and the consumers stop speaking the same language.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I also think it will make more sense to go microformats ->json-> xAPI to create constraints o. n metadata.

xAPI allows any affinity group to create vocabularies. At some point this just becomes words, not data and the consumers stop speaking the same language.
